The '''LPL 2022 Summer''' was the second split of the 2022 [[LoL Pro League]] ('''LPL''') season, organized by TJ Sports, from June 10 to September 1, 2022. The regular season featured a single round-robin, best-of-three format, with the top ten teams advancing to the playoffs. Playoffs consisted of a King-of-the-Hill stage followed by a double-elimination bracket, with all matches played in a best-of-five format. The tournament had a total prize pool of CNY 4,200,000, and the winner qualified for the 2022 [[World_Championship/2022|World Championship]] Main Event as the first seed. Matches were played on patches 12.10 through 12.15, with Bel’Veth and Nilah disabled for portions of the season. Games were held across multiple cities, including Shanghai, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and Xi’an, using a combination of offline and team home-ground venues.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 10<sup>th</sup> - August 14<sup>th</sup>, 2022''
** Single round robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Top 10 advanced to [[LPL/2022/Summer/Playoffs|Playoffs]]
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''7th till 10th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''11th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
** Tiebreakers
*** If two or more teams have won the same number of matches, the tie will be broken by the order:
***# Games differential
***# Head-to-head results

*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 16<sup>th</sup> - September 1<sup>st</sup>, 2022''
** '''''Phase One: King-of-the-Hill'''''
*** 3rd - 10th seeded teams from Group Stage are divided into two brackets to play a King-of-the-Hill format
**** 3rd, 6th, 7th and 10th seed are in one bracket (the first bracket), the other 4 seeds are in the other
**** The winners advance to Phase Two
**** The winner of the first bracket faces 2nd seed team in the Double-Elimination Stage, the other faces the 1st seed
** '''''Phase Two: Double-Elimination'''''
*** Four teams play in a Double-Elimination format to compete for the championship
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World_Championship/2022|World Championship 2022]] Main Event as the first seed.
